issue.title: Property-editor e2e focus click at (360,24) hits Obsidian's window close button at 390px

task_type_fields.impact: Narrow-viewport reopen silently kills the real-Obsidian property-editor acceptance run; today it only passes because of an ordering workaround.
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by bob-cli-pf.5.1.7 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-pf.5.1 land agent.

`focusApplicationWindow` in bob-plugins `scripts/obsidian-property-editor-e2e-diagnostics.cjs` (called at startup and by `openPropertyEditor` before every modal open in `scripts/obsidian-property-editor-e2e.cjs`) dispatches a CDP left click at the fixed viewport point (360, 24) to wake Chromium focus under Xvfb.

Repro: in the real-Obsidian property-editor runner, set the viewport to 390 px (the parity/surfaces screenshot matrices use `[390, "light"|"dark"]`), then close and reopen the Property Editor. The reopen's focus click drops the CDP session. pf.5.1.7 worked around it by restoring the 1400/light viewport after narrow captures before any further reopen.

Root cause (from the acceptance screenshots in artifact file:explicit:62ca3f23086f9033d49ae4ef): Obsidian's frameless title bar draws minimize at x~277 and maximize at x~323 in a 390 px window, so the ~46 px close button spans roughly x=344-390 at y<40. The fixed (360, 24) click lands on the window close button, which closes the Obsidian window and the CDP target with it. At 1400 px the same point falls on the tab header, which is why wide runs pass.

Fix: target a computed safe point (for example the active leaf's view-content center or the workspace root's bounding box queried through Runtime.evaluate) or skip the synthetic click when the viewport is narrow, and add an offline test in scripts/test-obsidian-property-editor-e2e.cjs asserting the click never falls inside `.titlebar-button-container` / `.mod-close` bounds for 390 and 1400 widths. Then remove the 1400-restore ordering workaround's dependence, or keep it only as layout hygiene.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-pf.5.1.7's acceptance run lost CDP on a narrow-viewport modal reopen and only worked around it; the fixed focus-click point lands on the frameless close button at 390px.
